title: Candidate decoding value bound
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with label set $ in q$, where $q>0$. For any family of finite candidate-label sets and any default label, the expected edge agreement from independently choosing labels at the vertices, using the default whenever a candidate set is empty, is at most the optimum value of the associated constraint satisfaction instance.
hypotheses_covered: The label set $ in q$ is nonempty ($q>0$)
A family of finite candidate-label sets indexed by vertices
A default label in $ in q$
